#226 correctness review, round 1: PASS

Exact head: 0379588ac951e565c287f2b885365c35749755e3.

No correctness findings in the five-file delta.

The callerless branch is reached only after Arguments::parse validates the command, positional arity and flags, and handle verifies route/family agreement. READ_LEAVES contains exactly the eight requested family/leaf pairs. read() implements only those queries and has no actor parameter; its fallback errors instead of dispatching a write. execute() delegates those same pairs to read(), and spine append is now an explicit separate actor-required branch. All other operations still pass through resolve_seat before their existing dispatch, role mutation or execute path.

has_caller uses the same nonblank session-ID/pane tests that resolve_seat applies. Thus a caller-bearing read still resolves and rejects unknown, retired or contradictory identities as before. Any parsed --actor value, including an empty value, prevents the callerless shortcut; a missing caller then receives E-RS-NO-CALLER, while a present caller still undergoes the existing actor-equality check. Missing/blank caller context cannot select a seat implicitly.

The extracted read implementations preserve their former results, filtering and errors. Project/stream/fence reads remain store queries; node_show remains the existing tree/report projection; spine events/render retain cursor validation, bounded paging and rendering without append. Both read entry paths retain the governance mutation lock. The new no-caller refusal remains HTTP 400 and ErrorKind::Refused, now with the documented stable code in details and its message prefix. Bearer authentication remains outside and ahead of these handlers.

Proof: clean detached tree at the exact head; just pr-freeze 226 returned FINAL, with remote/GitHub head agreement, CLEAN and all latest checks passed. CI run 42782287165 is successful at this head: 2,429 Rust tests passed, six skipped. Successful-job JUnit artifact 13746642569 individually records the eight-leaf callerless HTTP test passing, including write refusals, callerless --actor refusal and unauthenticated 401; all nine governance_u3 cases; both caller-bearing governance baseline cases; the forged-actor/unknown-flag no-mutation control; the paged spine control; and the adjusted unbounded-tail guard. Existing identity contradiction/unknown-seat controls also passed. git diff --check is clean.

No local builds, dependency changes, product edits, credential reads or daemon/lifecycle operations. No new loop, poll, timer or launch; callerless reads omit the previous caller lookup. No notes owed. Independent security grading remains with that role; this correctness review applies the stated C33 account boundary, not a new per-seat access policy.
